data.name: Vernice
data.gender_notes: Vernice is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek vera, meaning true, and nika, meaning victory. In Christian tradition, this name represents a faithful and true believer. The name Vernice carries the meaning “True, faithful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vernice usually hope their child will grow to embody true, faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of unwavering faith and commitment.
data.etymology: Vernice belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “True, faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vernice total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vernice refers to the ancient Greek roots with the meaning "true victory". Christendom in Europe recognized and adopted this name as it reflected the belief in the Christian truth and the desired victory of faith over the challenges and hardships of life.
data.spiritual_significance: Vernice is a name that symbolizes faithfulness, strength, and persistent perseverance. It is a reminder to the bearer that true victory comes not through worldly accomplishments or triumphs, but through maintaining a strong and unwavering faith in God. The name Vernice is a testament to the spiritual journey of a person who strives for inner victories, as they walk the path of the Christian faith, trusting in God's grace and guidance every step of the way.
